hypothesis: A single global threshold causes HH/HA/AA-specific errors; type-specific thresholds selected only from inner validation may stabilize the five-share operating point.
protocol: CTH 17 tasks, three outer task folds, exact five shares, same query-candidate pairs; 10000 task-cluster bootstrap; FMR<=10% threshold rule applied within type.
result: XGB type-threshold BA delta -3.44 pp (95% task interval [-7.52,+0.12]); FMR -5.63 pp and FSR +12.50 pp. Sparse validation cells included all-reject behavior.
single_change: Select separate HH/HA/AA thresholds from inner-task out-of-fold scores; preserve models, features, pairs and outer test galleries.

decision: Retain as same-source AA development/holdout evidence, not independent-source confirmation; this panel was opened before the all-pairs training revision.
hypothesis: A CTH Agent-only task holdout can test whether the mixed-role fingerprint increment transfers to unseen AA task groups within the same source.
protocol: Same-source AA-only task holdout; 59 traces, 23600 pairs per version; thresholds trained on original 17 CTH development tasks; no refit.
result: For XGB E+B/S vs E, BA -3.44 pp [-9.71,+1.93], FMR -6.15 pp and FSR +13.02 pp; no robust transfer.
single_change: Evaluate frozen CTH-trained models on 26 unused Agent-only task groups with a shared 100-repeat candidate panel.

decision: More pair coverage improves the recall-side signal but does not reduce both errors; the argument-conditioned comparison remains a development result.
hypothesis: Small sampled training-pair support may destabilize learned evidence weights and thresholding.
protocol: Frozen CTH five-share evaluation, same 54,400 test pairs per version, same outer folds and XGB fold configuration; 10000 paired task-cluster bootstrap.
result: With exhaustive training, E+B/S vs E BA +3.29 pp [-1.35,+8.66], FMR +0.70 pp, FSR -7.29 pp. E+Args+B/S vs E+Args BA +6.25 pp [1.17,+12.24], with FMR +0.56 pp and FSR -13.06 pp.
single_change: Replace the sampled training pairs with every distinct same-task positive and different-task negative pair; match total effective weight and equalize label and HH/HA/AA cell mass.

decision: Does not meet robust-gain rule because both error rates do not decrease, SVM harms, and independent HH/HA evidence is absent. Do not reopen NYU for threshold, model, representation, or task selection.
hypothesis: A CTH-trained B/S association signal may transfer to unseen challenge groups from a separate public CTF submission repository.
protocol: Frozen before model fit. Train on 17 mixed-role CTH tasks; test on 160 previously unused NYU task groups, 585 D-CIPHER runs. 100 repeated 1-positive/3-negative galleries per run, 234000 identical pairs per learner/version, 10k task-cluster bootstrap. Same-challenge filename is a retrieval proxy; AA only.
result: Paired E+B/S minus E BA: SVM -8.23 pp [-10.22,-6.28], tree +3.64 [+1.97,+5.37], XGB +5.71 [+3.63,+7.73]. Tree and XGB both trade lower FSR for higher FMR; XGB FMR +14.67 pp and FSR -26.10 pp. XGB Hit@1 +3.20 [+0.45,+5.90], MRR +1.94 [+0.06,+3.74], AUC +1.82 [-0.38,+3.97].
single_change: One preregistered external evaluation of the fixed E vs E+B/S arms for SVM, depth-3 tree and depth-3 XGBoost; no NYU-driven tuning.
